lines: Fannin has played 86% of snaps both over his last 3 games and for the season. Targets are up lately, 7.7 per game versus 6.2 for the year.
He's averaging 95.7 receiving yards and 17.2 PPR points per game over his last 3, compared with 54.4 yards and 11.8 points for the season.
The coach said Fannin will keep getting targeted early and on vertical routes as a featured weapon. Cleveland is on a bye in Wk 11.
